name: Husqvarna 460 Rancher
blurb: 18″, 20″ and 24″ bar setups on 3/8″ chain, .050″ / .058″ gauge, 68–84 drive links — straight from Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 460 Rancher is a rear-handle gas saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 3 approved bar lengths for it (18″, 20″ and 24″), running 3/8″ pitch chain in .050″ / .058″ gauge.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bar Rancher 599999868 and chain S83G X-Cut 585639068.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar Rancher 599999872 and chain S83G X-Cut 585639072.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar Rancher 599999972 and chain H81 591153972.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 24″ setup with bar Rancher 599807084 and chain S83G X-Cut 585639084.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide 2026 (effective 1 January 2026) — certified/approved bar and chain combinations per saw

sources_note: Husqvarna 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026), read in full on 24 Oct 2026; every row in the table is restated from the saw's entry in that guide.
